description: One child has an endotracheal tube whose removal time is 19 November 2157, the source's mark for a device that is still in place.

expectations.says: The tube is written as an endotracheal tube with a start and an empty end.
expectations.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS devices FROM omop.device_exposure d JOIN omop.person p ON p.person_id = d.person_id WHERE p.person_source_value = '990001011' AND d.device_concept_id = 4097216 AND d.device_exposure_start_datetime IS NOT NULL AND d.device_exposure_end_datetime IS NULL

expectations.says: The tube belongs to the visit detail of the anaesthetic.
expectations.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS devices FROM omop.device_exposure d JOIN omop.visit_detail vd ON vd.visit_detail_id = d.visit_detail_id WHERE vd.visit_detail_source_value = '990001031'
